description: This file is a C header file for the FreeType library, specifically for computing exact outline bounding boxes. It declares the function FT_Outline_Get_BBox used to calculate the bounding box of a font outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_BBox
methods.description: Computes the exact bounding box of a font outline, traversing Bézier arcs to find extrema for precise bounding box calculation.
